svg.title: Security design area of the Azure landing zone
svg.desc: Own layout, because the Microsoft Learn Security page has no diagram. Left column, security operations: alerts and incidents with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel; logs in a central Log Analytics workspace; controls and vulnerability management with Azure Policy; encryption and keys in Azure Key Vault; and attestation of virtual machine boot integrity. Middle column, access control, where the perimeter has two parts: network security controls (internet connectivity, segmentation, network encryption, traffic inspection) and Zero Trust access controls (verify explicitly, use least-privilege access, assume breach, with Privileged Identity Management). Right column, what the reference architecture includes: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure DDoS Network Protection (optional), Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall and Privileged Identity Management, plus six policies for online and corporate-connected landing zones. A note says security operations, asset protection and innovation security are out of scope for this design area. Icons are official Azure icons.
